title: AFN Kunsan Pacific Update – Aircraft Arresting Systems
description: Members of the Aircraft Arresting Systems, assigned to the 8th Fighter Wing, thoroughly maintain and monitor arresting gear on the flight line of Kunsan Air Base. The Aircraft Arresting Systems team mission is to safely arrest aircrafts that experience trouble during aborted take-offs or emergency landings.
keywords: arresting gear, Kunsan Air Base, 8th Fighter Wing, Wolf Pack, Aircraft Arresting Systems, SSgt Thomas Mueller, AIr Force, maintenance, safety, Korea., flight line

transcript.text: (upbeat music)
- Members of the aircraft arresting systems
safely arrest aircraft
that experience trouble during aborted takeoffs
or emergency landings.
- I'm Staff Sergeant Thomas Mueller
a noncommissioned officer
in charge of Aircraft Arresting Systems,
eight civil engineering squadron.
- Purpose of an aircraft arresting system
is to stop fighter aircraft
in the event of an in-flight emergency
or high-speed abort takeoff situation.
The system is used to prevent damage to the aircraft
and it saves lives.
We conduct daily maintenance and system inspections
to ensure the barriers aircraft ready at all times
in the event of an in-flight emergency.
Our job is important
so that the aircraft doesn't get damaged
and we can save the pilot's life.
- I like how exclusive it is working on the active runway
as a seee troop.
- I'm specialist CaShaunta Williams AFN Kunsan.
(upbeat music)
